name: Swarm of Vitality Bats
biography: A Small swarm of Tiny fey bats made of crimson life essence, conjured and conducted by Grand Maestro Sangrimm's Sanguine Swarm attack.

features.name: Life Force
features.description: When the swarm is created, it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat.

features.name: Will of the Master
features.description: The swarm is connected to a master that controls it. If the swarm's master is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the swarm immediately dies in a puff of smoke.

features.name: Latch On
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the swarm attaches to the target. While attached, the swarm moves with the target and can't be removed unless it chooses to detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The swarm has Advantage on attack rolls made against a creature it's attached to.

features.name: Leech
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft., one creature that the swarm is attached to. Hit: 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage. If the target is a CR 1+ creature, the swarm's master gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken.
